question: Is the real local Worker and Durable Object before-and-after evidence sufficient to merge under a monitored natural-failure canary, or must this PR wait for staging, shadow, or naturally occurring deployed-path proof?
rationale: The reviewed patch is internally coherent and well covered, but automation cannot decide whether the unobserved deployed Actions, lease, publication, and router interactions are an acceptable rollout risk.

options.title: Approve monitored canary
options.body: Accept the deterministic local integration proof, merge with the documented rollback criteria, and capture the first naturally occurring failed-shard run without manufacturing a failure.

options.title: Wait for deployed proof
options.body: Keep the PR draft until staging, shadow, or a naturally occurring deployed failure demonstrates the acknowledgement, lease, publication, marker-suppression, routing, and bounded-completion invariants.

recommendation.title: Approve monitored canary
recommendation.body: Accept the deterministic local integration proof, merge with the documented rollback criteria, and capture the first naturally occurring failed-shard run without manufacturing a failure.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a live ClawSweeper rollout and proof-acceptance choice rather than a remaining mechanical code repair.
